 Prayer:  Contempt Petition is filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Court  Act, 1971, to initiate contempt proceedings against the Contemnors and p  them for the wilful disobedience of the order of the High Court in  W.P.(MD)No.14650 of 2024 dated 04.07.2024.
 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Louis  For Respondents : Mr.A.Baskaran,

A.R.Sankaralingam vs R.Lalvena on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121701078/
1  ORDER The instant contempt petition has been filed alleging violation of the order of this Court dated 04.07.2024 made in W.P(MD)No.14650 of 2024. 
2. The learned Counsel appearing for the contempt petitioner submitted that against the order of this Court made in W.P.(MD).No.14650 of 2024 dated 04.07.2027, a writ appeal in W.A.(MD).No.2354 of 2024 has been filed. The Honourable Division Bench of this Court has granted interim stay in the said writ appeal on 19.11.2024. 
3. Recording the same, this contempt petition stands closed. However, the petitioner is at liberty to revive the contempt petition depending upon the outcome of the W.A.(MD).No.2354 of 2024.
